contracts.fixture_boundary: The fixture's fake read store exposes only monitoring-session reads. The separate fake mutation owner is wrapped by PersonaProvisioningReconciliationMutationPort and injected into bff_main for each test.

contracts.production_boundary: No production file is changed by this task; the production port and composition remain owned by OPGAP-BE-PERSONA-RECONCILIATION-MUTATION-PORT-20260830.

composition_verification.reason: The typed mutation-port delivery is merged into dev. This task branch was rebased onto that merge commit before the composed suite ran, while retaining its fixture-only scope.
composition_verification.details: The rebased composed delivery passed 55 tests in 27.89s: 52 legacy authoritative readback tests and 3 focused read-surface mutation-boundary tests. The suite emitted 10 pre-existing Python/FastAPI/jsonschema deprecation warnings.
